questions.question: If sin A = (3)/(5) , and A is an acute angle, then find the value of 2cot² A - csc² A .
questions.solution:
**Given:**

sin A = 3/5

**Formula Used:**

sin²A + cos²A = 1

cot A = cos A ÷ sin A

csc A = 1 ÷ sin A

**Calculation:**

⇒ cos A = √(1 - (3/5)²)

⇒ cos A = √(1 - 9/25)

⇒ cos A = √(16/25)

⇒ cos A = 4/5

⇒ cot A = (4/5) ÷ (3/5)

⇒ cot A = 4/3

⇒ cot²A = (4/3)²

⇒ cot²A = 16/9

⇒ csc A = 1 ÷ (3/5)

⇒ csc A = 5/3

⇒ csc²A = (5/3)²

⇒ csc²A = 25/9

⇒ 2cot²A - csc²A = 2 × (16/9) - 25/9

⇒ 32/9 - 25/9

⇒ 7/9

**∴ The correct answer is 7/9.**

questions.question: A, B and C can do a piece of work in 2, 20 and 5 days respectively. How long (in days) will they take to do thrice the same work, working together?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A = 2 days

B = 20 days

C = 5 days

**Formula Used:**

Work = LCM of given times

Efficiency = Work ÷ Time

Total Time = Total Work ÷ Combined Efficiency

**Calculation:**

⇒ LCM of 2, 20, 5 = 20

⇒ Efficiency of A = 20 ÷ 2 = 10

⇒ Efficiency of B = 20 ÷ 20 = 1

⇒ Efficiency of C = 20 ÷ 5 = 4

⇒ Total Efficiency = 10 + 1 + 4 = 15

⇒ Work for one job = 20

⇒ Work for three jobs = 20 × 3 = 60

⇒ Time = 60 ÷ 15

⇒ Time = 4

**∴ The correct answer is 4.**

questions.question: Walking at (4)/(7) of his normal speed, Abhijet is 36 minutes late in reaching his office. The usual time taken by him to cover the distance between his home and his office is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Reduced speed = 4/7 of normal speed

Delay = 36 minutes

**Formula Used:**

Time ∝ 1 ÷ Speed

Difference in time = New time − Original time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let original time = t

⇒ New time = t × (7/4)

⇒ Difference = t × (7/4) − t

⇒ Difference = t × (7/4 − 1)

⇒ Difference = t × (3/4)

⇒ t × (3/4) = 36

⇒ t = 36 × 4 ÷ 3

⇒ t = 48

**∴ The correct answer is 48.**

questions.question: Which of the following expressions is the simplified form of (2x + 5)(2x - 5) - (2x - 3)² ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use the identity: (a + b)(a − b) = a² − b².

Simplify (2x + 5)(2x − 5) ⇒ 4x² − 25.

Simplify −(2x − 3)² ⇒ −(4x² − 12x + 9).

Combine terms: 4x² − 25 − 4x² + 12x − 9 ⇒ 12x − 34.

Factorize: 2(6x − 17).

**∴ Answer = 2(6x − 17)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression: (2x + 5)(2x − 5) − (2x − 3)²

**Formula used:**

(a + b)(a − b) = a² − b²

**Calculations:**

(2x + 5)(2x − 5) = 4x² − 25.

⇒ −(2x − 3)² = −(4x² − 12x + 9).

⇒ Combine: 4x² − 25 − 4x² + 12x − 9 = 12x − 34.

⇒ Factorize: 2(6x − 17).

**∴ The correct answer is 2(6x − 17).**

questions.question: The average age of 31 students of a class is 14 years. If the age of the teacher is also included, the average age of the whole group becomes 15 years. The age (in years) of the teacher is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total age of 31 students = Average × Number of students = 14 × 31 = 434 years.

Total age of the group (including teacher) = Average × Total people = 15 × 32 = 480 years.

Age of the teacher = Total group age − Total student age = 480 − 434 = 46 years.

**∴ Answer = 46**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average age of 31 students = 14 years

Average age of group (students + teacher) = 15 years

Total students = 31 | Total group = 32

**Formula used:**

Age of teacher = (Average age of group × Total group) − (Average age of students × Total students)

 
 Students
 Total age = 434 years
 
 Group (Students + Teacher)
 Total age = 480 years
 
• 
 Teacher = 46 years

**Calculations:**

Total age of students = 14 × 31 = 434 years

⇒ Total age of group = 15 × 32 = 480 years

⇒ Age of teacher = 480 − 434 = 46 years

**∴ The correct answer is 46.**

questions.question: In a class examination, the average score of 35 students was 44. Later, it was discovered that twice 25 was wrongly recorded as 33, and once 36 was wrongly recorded as 34. What is the actual average score of the class?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total error = (33 − 25) × 2 + (34 − 36) → 16 − 2 = 14

Correct total marks = Old total marks − Total error

Old total marks = Average × Students = 44 × 35 = 1540

Correct total = 1540 − 14 = 1526

Correct average = Correct total ÷ Students = 1526 ÷ 35 ≈ 43.6

**∴ Answer = 43.6**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Students = 35, Old average = 44

Errors: (33 instead of 25 twice) and (34 instead of 36 once)

**Formula used:**

Correct average = (Old total marks − Total error) ÷ Total students

 Old Total Marks = 1540 Error: (33 − 25) × 2 + (34 − 36) = 14 Correct Total Marks = 1540 − 14 = 1526 Correct Average = 1526 ÷ 35 ≈ 43.6 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Old total = Average × Students = 44 × 35 = 1540

⇒ Total error = (33 − 25) × 2 + (34 − 36) = 14

⇒ Correct total = 1540 − 14 = 1526

⇒ Correct average = 1526 ÷ 35 ≈ 43.6

**∴ The correct answer is 43.6 (Option 1).**

questions.question: If 20% of a number is added to 72, then the result is the same number. 65% of the same number is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the number be N.

Given: 20% of N + 72 = N.

⇒ N − 0.2N = 72 ⇒ 0.8N = 72 ⇒ N = 72 ÷ 0.8 = 90.

65% of N = 65 ÷ 100 × 90 = 58.5.

**∴ Answer = 58.5**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

20% of a number + 72 = Same number.

Find 65% of the number.

**Formula used:**

Percentage formula: Required value = Percentage ÷ 100 × Total.

 Total Number (N) 
• 20% of N Added 72 Final Number: N = 90 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 20% of N + 72 = N.

⇒ N − 0.2N = 72 ⇒ 0.8N = 72.

⇒ N = 72 ÷ 0.8 = 90.

⇒ 65% of N = 65 ÷ 100 × 90 = 58.5.

**∴ The correct answer is 58.5.**
